input.query: SELECT signup_month, channel, SUM(n_signups) n_signups, SUM(n_activated) n_activated, SUM(n_activated)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) activation_rate, SUM(n_kyc_approved)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) kyc_approval_rate, SUM(n_first_topup)::DOUBLE/SUM(n_signups) topup_rate FROM agg_funnel_monthly WHERE channel='organic' AND signup_month IN (TIMESTAMP '2026-03-01', TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT signup_month, COUNT(*) n, AVG(CASE WHEN is_activated THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) activation_rate, AVG(CASE WHEN is_email_verified THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) email_rate, AVG(CASE WHEN is_kyc_started THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) kyc_start_rate, AVG(CASE WHEN is_doc_submitted THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) doc_rate, AVG(CASE WHEN is_kyc_approved THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) approval_rate, AVG(CASE WHEN has_topup THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) topup_rate FROM dim_users WHERE channel='organic' AND signup_month BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2026-05-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
